summary: The lord of marriage and partnership joins the self, so partners shape the person's identity. Raman and Braha read a spouse known from childhood and a stable partnership; Rath adds a dominating streak; BPHS is critical, describing restlessness and wandering affections.
common_outcomes: May marry someone known since childhood or from the same household (Raman; Braha)

Braha: healthy, powerful, respected; 7th-house matters especially fruitful because the lord aspects its own house

by_area.personality: Intelligent and able to weigh pros and cons (Raman); healthy, powerful, respected (Braha); dominating (Rath). BPHS 24.73: clever but unsteady (traditional view).

by_area.relationships: Marriage to someone known since childhood (Raman; Braha); strict with the spouse (Rath); BPHS 24.73's line on others' spouses is a traditional view.
